description: Get spending grouped by recipient/merchant. Each Moneda user gets their own bucket; off-ramps share a single bucket per type (bank-withdrawal, external-wallet, coinbase, wallet-connect). Amounts are in currency units (26.5 means 26.50), like `get_transactions`.

from.description: ISO 8601 UTC start of an absolute window

period.description: Rolling time window. Mutually exclusive with from/to.

to.description: ISO 8601 UTC end of an absolute window

name: get_spending_by_merchant
